title: HaluEval (QA) question record (uncertainty study)
description: One question of the HaluEval (QA) set (multi-hop facts) used by thesis Objectives 1-2. Mirrors the Item dataclass in uncertainty/sets/load.py.
x-format: JSON Lines: one JSON object per line, each matching this schema
x-note: Documentation only: no code reads this schema.

id.description: Unique question id in this set: 'halu-' + the source dataset's own id.

set.description: Name of the question set: always 'halueval'.

kind.description: Answer kind 'short': free-text answer, graded by an LLM judge from another model family.

question.description: The question as sent to the model.

split.description: Fixed, seeded split: dev (30%) only tunes thresholds and trains the Objective 2 models; every reported number uses test (70%).

core.description: true if the question is in the core tier, the subset every model answers; the file itself is the extended tier.

judge_mode.description: How the LLM judge grades a free-text answer: match (agrees with a reference answer), truthfulqa (TruthfulQA judge prompt), abstain (correct only if it says the question cannot be answered), premise (correct only if it rejects the false premise). Unused for rule-graded kinds.

incorrect_answers.description: Known false answers from the dataset (TruthfulQA only; empty elsewhere).

gold_type.description: Always null: the dataset gives no uncertainty type for these questions.

evidence.description: The dataset's knowledge paragraph(s) for the question (at most 1,200 characters). Used only by the Objective 2 knowledge intervention.

hint.description: Always null: this set has no hint.

meta.description: No extra fields in this set (always an empty object).

examples.question: Are Sparta and King Charles both from the same country?
examples.evidence: Sparta is an American rock band from El Paso, Texas, formed in 2001.King Charles (born Charles Costa, 6 May 1985) is a singer-songwriter from West London.
